title: Select and materialize CAP-INV-006 bounded reuse-first capability wave
goal: Validate the fresh reuse-first-v1 selection of CAP-INV-006 against its canonical Saved Searches and Query Assets contract and materialize exactly one bounded non-mutating implementation wave while OPEN-013 remains unresolved.
inputs: VERIFIED E10-SCALE-004A readiness and wave-selection evidence
canonical CAP-INV-006 Saved Searches and Query Assets Product Spec contract
canonical Shared Query and Search Job objects
tenant, permission, audit, correlation and search-query implementation contracts
outputs: fresh source-backed confirmation of CAP-INV-006 selection
bounded non-mutating Saved Search / Query Asset implementation-wave manifest
invariants: product runtime code is not changed by scaling-control tasks
CAP-INV family preference does not imply runtime-boundary reuse
Query remains Shared-owned and is never duplicated into an Investigate canonical object
Saved View remains Shared-owned and Detection Rule remains outside this capability
save/share/duplicate/deprecate and other class-2 asset mutations remain excluded from the bounded wave
no provider, storage engine, retention policy, final query dialect, collaboration backend or final UI is invented
security_properties: selected canonical capability path must resolve inside the read-only Product Spec
tenant scope and permission evaluation are server-side and deny-by-default
execution handoff re-evaluates sources and permissions and preserves the original Query/version
wave decomposition must split any task exceeding complexity budgets
acceptance_tests: canonical Saved Searches and Query Assets capability file and referenced obligations resolve
OPEN-013 class-2 mutations remain explicitly excluded
all generated child manifests pass strict-v2 and complexity validation
one first child is READY and all later children are dependency-gated

performance_budget.rationale: control-plane decomposition only; runtime budgets are compiled in capability child work before runtime implementation

migration.rationale: no product runtime or persistent data is changed

rollback.strategy: revert the wave materialization without changing verified runtimes or the ledger

definition_of_done: selection is exactly READY and source-backed
canonical CAP-INV-006 contract is reflected in a bounded non-mutating wave
child lots stay within complexity budgets
one next READY implementation task exists
